newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil basket rises $0.35 to $21.40 in wk.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil basket rises $0.35 to $21.40 in wk.

text.p: The average export price for Venezuela's basket of crude and products rose $0.35 to $21.40 on Friday, compared to $21.05 on Sept 6, the Energy and Mines Ministry said.
The average price for the year so far is $17.35 per barrel, the ministry statement said.
Venezuela's oil export price averaged $14.84 per barrel last year compared to $13.23 per barrel in 1994.
The Venezuelan government has based its revised 1996 budget calculations on an average price of $15.60 per barrel.
